messages:
ellie_am: Quick ask — FellowsHealth (acct FH-778) just hit a massive ingestion spike during a scheduled data migration. They were billed for the overage (INV-2026-4123) and are requesting a one-off credit of $18,000 plus a 30-day extension on their Dedicated trial while we investigate. Can we get approval?

sanjay_sales: Saw their email. Migration script misconfigured, our side acknowledged higher token counts. They're high-touch, looks like a strategic healthcare partner. I support a partial or full credit.

maria_finance: Need details: is invoice posted already? what's the billing period? will this be a recurring usage pattern or one-off? Also capture GL code for credit.

ellie_am: Invoice is posted (May 3). Billing period Apr 25–May 2. SRE confirmed migration spike was caused by customer script, but they reached out immediately and followed remediation steps. Likely one-off.

devon_revops: FYI quoting note: they were on a trial Dedicated config; we had a temporary elevated ingestion allowance that didn't apply because trial caps were enforced differently. We can offer a one-time credit and a trial extension. Need finance sign-off for >$10k credits.

maria_finance: If it's >$10k, we need a formal deal desk approval + a GL entry. Can we reduce to $12k and waive the rest as CS goodwill? Need to see expected ARR retention.
sanjay_sales: Retention probability high; they're planning to go into paid Dedicated next quarter for production. ARR estimate ~$120k/year. I recommend full $18k credit to lock them in.
maria_finance: Ok. Please provide a one-line business justification and retention estimate for the approval doc.
ellie_am: Business justification: migration caused inflated usage; credit requested to preserve relationship and keep conversion timeline unaffected. Estimated ARR $110–130k next 12 months.
billing-bot: Note: Credit memo CM-2026-078 queued. Current approval status: pending finance approval.
maria_finance: Approve in principle, contingent on legal sign-off for a one-off amendment to include Net30 billing terms. Also cap the credit to invoice INV-2026-4123 only (no future bill adjustments).
devon_revops: I'll draft the amendment and add a line: "one-time credit applied to INV-2026-4123; trial extended 30 days; no precedent set."
dollie_cfo: (sorry jumped in) I approve the full $18k one-off credit given the retention impact and ARR. Please log as exec-approved exception.
maria_finance: Confirmed receipt of CFO approval. I'll route CM-2026-078 for processing and create a comment in NetSuite. GL will use code 7302 (Customer Credits — Exceptions).
ellie_am: Thanks all. I'll send FellowsHealth the confirmation and the 30-day trial extension. Devon, please share the amendment draft.
devon_revops: Drafted — attaching snippet below for review:
```
Amendment: Redwood Inference agrees to issue a one-time credit of $18,000 applied to invoice INV-2026-4123. The Customer will receive a 30-day extension to their Dedicated trial. This credit is a one-time customer success gesture and does not change pricing or create precedent.
```
sanjay_sales: LGTM. forwarding to client now. :white_check_mark:
ellie_am: I'll mark thread resolved after billing posts the credit memo. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
